Class ReviewManager

java.lang.Object
application.ReviewManager
public class ReviewManager extends Object

The ReviewManager class is responsible for managing all reviews within the system. It supports adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving reviews, as well as printing them for testing or debugging purposes.

Internally, all reviews are stored in a List of Review objects.
